children: Invesco Mortgage Capital declared a $0.12-per-share November dividend and reported preliminary financial metrics as of October 31, 2026.
The monthly dividend is payable December 14 to stockholders of record November 24; the ex-dividend date is also November 24.
Estimated book value was $7.01 per common share as of October 31.
The investment portfolio, including TBAs, totaled $8.1 billion, with $413.2 million in unrestricted cash and unencumbered securities.
Repurchase agreement borrowings were $6.7 billion; debt-to-equity was 7.2x and economic debt-to-equity was 7.9x.
October figures are preliminary and unaudited, and may be materially revised during ongoing closing processes.
